CLIP: [On screen: Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.]
a man in period dress: "Your father paid me to watch over you."
[Sound: The crowd gasps.]
[Hard cut]
[On screen: Medium two-shot of the man in period dress and the figure in period dress, the space between them charged.]
a man in period dress: "They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!"
[On screen: Close-up on the the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
a figure in period dress: "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
[Action: the widow grabs the figure in period dress by the wrist.]
a figure in period dress: "If I say yes, the harbour keeps its tongue."
[On screen: Low angle on the figure in period dress framed against the lighthouse beam.]
a figure in period dress: "The council has already decided her fate."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
[On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
[On screen: High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.]
a figure in period dress: "The ring smells of your rose oil, Selene."
